integrity.computational_checks: Exact-rational examples and boundary predicates only; finite checks are not used as proof of the universal claim.
integrity.proof: An analytical proof of the all-parameter classification is included in RESULT.md.
integrity.source_access: The asymmetric-interval article was read in open-access full text; two broader moment-inequality sources were inspected at abstract/metadata level only.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one real random variable with mean zero and second moment one and two one-sided threshold events.
No density, symmetry, unimodality, higher-moment, or lattice-support restriction is treated.
A general moment-optimization framework may recover equivalent statements by specialization; exhaustive priority is not claimed.
The full text of the multiple-Cantelli paper was not accessible in the inspected sources.
title: Exact feasibility of asymmetric tail-probability pairs under two moments
